name: LiveAgent
description: LiveAgent is an all-in-one customer service platform that merges email, live chat, phone, and social messaging into a single ticketing dashboard with a built-in call center.
best_for: Businesses of various sizes handling multiple communication channels who want fast live chat and first-contact resolution in one dashboard.
features: Multichannel ticketing that unifies email, chat, phone, and social messages
Built-in call center with IVR and call routing
Live chat widget marketed as one of the fastest on the market
AI chatbot answering common questions in 100+ languages
Social media integration for Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Viber, and Telegram
Self-service knowledge base to deflect tickets
AI Answer Assistant for polishing and generating agent replies
